# 92nd Drama League Awards

| venue = The Ziegfeld Ballroom
}}
The 92nd Drama League Awards are to be held on May 15, 2026, recognizing excellence in Broadway and Off-Broadway productions during the 2025–26 season. Nominations were announced on April 20, 2026,.
Winners and nominees
The 2024-2025 Drama League Awards nominations were announced on Monday, April 20, 2026, by Corbin Bleu and Natalie Venetia Belcon. The awards ceremony is to take place on Friday, May 15, 2026, at the The Ziegfeld Ballroom.
